prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one original gray rabbit aviation mascot, full-body 1930s rubber-hose cartoon. Extremely long upright gray ears. The character is an adult, fully clothed, friendly nonsexual mascot. Relaxed smile, one hand on hip, the other holds a small orange carrot with green leaves. Clean 2D ink with black contours, primarily grey and white colors. No headwear, no goggles, no bulky outer jacket. Transparent background, no UI, words, badges, logos, scenery, floor or shadow. Show the entire character, ears and shoes fully in frame with a little clear transparent margin. This is a brand-new independent drawing, not an edit of any previous image.
